exposure: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) coexisting with hypertensive disorder complicating pregnancy (HDP)
Individualized treatment (glycemic and blood pressure control)
outcome: Metabolic parameters (e.g., glycemic control, blood pressure control)
cohort: The study involved 82 pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus complicated by hypertensive disorder and 118 healthy pregnant controls.
finding: Pre-pregnancy metabolic factors, including BMI, fasting blood glucose, triglycerides, and HDL cholesterol, are strong independent predictors of GDM complicated by HDP, and individualized treatment targeting glycemic and blood pressure control can significantly improve metabolic parameters and reduce complications.
mod_finding: Women with GDM complicated by HDP exhibited significantly higher rates of cesarean delivery compared to healthy controls.
